definitions.explanation: The act of keeping someone or something safe from harm, damage, or loss.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}を{保護|ほご}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to protect the environment.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}に{保護|ほご}された。
examples.english: I was taken into police protection.

examples.japanese: {絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧|きぐ}{種|しゅ}を{保護|ほご}する{法律|ほうりつ}がある。
examples.english: There are laws to protect endangered species.

notes:
USAGE: {保護|ほご} is used in contexts ranging from environmental protection to legal protection to parental care.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{保護|ほご}する (to protect)
・{保護|ほご}を{受|う}ける (to receive protection)
・{保護|ほご}の{下|もと}に (under protection)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{環境|かんきょう}{保護|ほご} (environmental protection)
・{保護|ほご}{者|しゃ} (guardian, protector)
・{保護|ほご}{動物|どうぶつ} (protected animal)
・{消費者|しょうひしゃ}{保護|ほご} (consumer protection)
・{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}{保護|ほご} (personal data protection)
